description: Makes the courier’s CSV of up to 100 orders named in ids, with action export_csv: one row per order with the order number, recipient, phone, address, city, postcode, map link, items, total, payment, the cash to collect, delivery day, courier and tracking number. Returns a link to the file that works for an hour. Changes no order and sends nothing.
name: export_orders_csv
title: Export orders for the courier
